function_knobs: wg_width: waveguide width (~0.84 μm) - controls modal behavior and coupling strength
coupler_gap: spacing between guide centerlines (~0.07 μm) - affects coupling efficiency
coupling_length: active coupling region length (~100 μm) - determines power split ratio
num_guides: number of parallel guides (6) - structure of coupler cores
notes: Device is a symmetric directional coupler with filled multimode boxes serving as input/output regions. The tight spacing and number of guides define the coupling behavior. Topology is correct but IoU capped ~0.50 suggesting missing geometric features (e.g., curved transitions) or measurement calibration effects.
